Name: Akira's Haley Touchups (1.6)
Author: ikeychain
Description:
[b]What does this mod do? 

[/b][list]
[*]Shorten the length of her skirt by a bit. 
[*]Smoothed out the length of her hair, it sticks out less on the sides.
[*]Made her camera smaller, more realistic and it matches closer with the camera prop in her room.
[*]Fixed some inconsistent sprites where Haley doesn't have socks.
[*]Adjusts the shape of her shoes in some sprites.
[/list]
[b]This mod is not available anywhere but Nexusmods.com. If you find it elsewhere, it is likely not by the original creator. 
[/b][size=2]
